body:
## Problem
`buildActionArtifact` in `packages/backlog-groom/lib/gate.mjs` omits the issue title, current labels, issue body, and verified paths, so an independent adversarial reviewer has no issue context to verify and demotes every action (#1061).

## Solution
1. Export `MAX_ARTIFACT_BODY_CHARS = 4000` from `packages/backlog-groom/lib/gate.mjs` and update `buildActionArtifact(action)` so that when `action.title`, `action.labels` (non-empty), `action.verifiedPaths` (non-empty), or `action.body` (non-empty, truncated at `MAX_ARTIFACT_BODY_CHARS` with `\n...(truncated)`) are present on `action`, they are rendered in the artifact while preserving byte-for-byte identical output when those optional fields are absent.
2. In `packages/backlog-groom/lib/apply.mjs`, have `revalidateAction` return `title`, `body`, `labels`, and `verifiedPaths` from the freshly fetched `issue` and `recomputed` verification result on `{ ok: true, ... }`, and enrich each `revalidated` action in `applyRun` with those fields before `gateAction` and `executeActions`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: `buildActionArtifact` includes `- title:`, `- current labels:`, `- verified paths:`, and `## Issue body` (truncated at `MAX_ARTIFACT_BODY_CHARS`) when present on `action`, and preserves exact golden output when absent.
- AC2: `revalidateAction` returns the verified `title`, `body`, `labels`, and `verifiedPaths`, and `applyRun` threads them onto each revalidated action so `runReview`, `gateAction`, and `executeActions` all bind to the enriched artifact digest.
- AC3: All tests in `packages/backlog-groom/test/` pass with 0 surviving mutants.
title: backlog-groom: include issue context in review artifacts so --apply can verify actions (#1061)
